scoring_justification: Full recompute from raw free-energy artifact not guaranteed; instead cross-check final outputs against paper-reported gold phases and transition temperatures and verify susceptibility trend.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold phase labels for a subset of grid points extracted from paper's zero-T phase diagram (Fig 3a)
hidden_assets.generation_method: Manually selected points clearly inside each phase based on paper's description and known Lanczos boundaries
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Points correspond to unambiguous regions; finite-T transitions for some points confirm ground-state phase as R.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold transition temperatures T_c from paper text (Sec. III)
hidden_assets.source_provenance: paper text: k_B T/J = 0.39 for (0.6,0.5) and 0.64 for (1.25,2.0)
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are explicitly stated in the paper

outputs.description: Ground-state phase labels (N, R, or F) for a grid of coupling ratios. The checker compares each point against hidden gold extracted from the paper's zero-temperature phase diagram. Exact match is required; partial credit per point.

Thermal transition temperatures T_c (in units of k_B T/J) from the R-type to the N-type state for two specific coupling sets. The checker compares the reported values to hidden gold transition temperatures with a predefined tolerance.

Uniform spin susceptibility χ at two temperatures for one coupling set. The checker verifies that χ at T=0.6 is greater than χ at T=0.2 (structural inequality), confirming the increasing trend through the thermal transition.

output_contract.notes: The scored artifacts collectively reproduce the core computational claims of the paper: the zero-temperature phase diagram, two specific finite-temperature transition points, and the trend of increasing susceptibility at the transition. All numeric gold values remain hidden from the public contract.
